QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_3

question.text: Operational DD specific to Cat III AIFs should include:

answer.text: Internal controls, service-provider review, counterparty risk, valuation methodology, cyber security, and business-continuity/disaster recovery

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XIX-B workbook, operational due diligence on Category III AIFs covers internal controls, third-party service provider reviews (custodians, fund administrators), and business continuity/disaster recovery checks (pages 260-261), alongside operational risk, third-party reliance, disaster recovery, and cyber-security risk (page 210). Pages 137-138 add valuation methodology and fair valuation, and page 209 covers counterparty risk arising from brokers, dealers, banks, NBFCs, distributors, custodians, and financial institutions. The Trap: Options A, C, and D each isolate one slice (audit, returns, team size) and miss the multi-dimensional ODD scope the workbook describes. Note: Anchor ODD scope to the workbook areas above - internal controls, service-provider/counterparty review, valuation, cyber-security, and disaster recovery - rather than to general industry terms not used in the workbook.
